output.one_liner: Agentic B2B support platform that tracks customer issues across channels and enables AI agents to investigate, take action, and resolve them.

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 for interactive clients and MCP, scoped API tokens for programmatic access

evidence.snippet: Sign in with OAuth or use an API token
Auth is OAuth 2.0 or an API token. Transport is Streamable HTTP (stateless).

access.notes: Free trials available but require sales representative to set up demo organization; no self-serve free tier

evidence.snippet: Pylon offers free trials for prospects. Your sales representative will work with you on setting up the demo organization.
US server: mcp.usepylon.com; EU server: mcp.eu.usepylon.com
Pylon's MCP server exposes your Pylon workspace (issues, accounts, contacts, and more)

buildability.rationale: MCP and REST APIs documented with published tools; Composio toolkit already exists; friction from sales-gated credentials.

overview_evidence.snippet: Pylon is the first agentic support platform built for B2B. Track customer issues across any channel and orchestrate agents and Automations to investigate, take action, and resolve customer issues.
Build support, account, and product intelligence across conversations, CRM, product usage, logs, and code, then make it available via MCP to your agents and team.

unknown_reasons.api_surface: Full REST API documentation scope and rate limits not documented in provided pages; breadth inferred from 12 MCP tools plus REST endpoints
